
# AfghanUstad

> AfghanUstad provides practical computer and technology education in Afghanistan.

AfghanUstad helps learners develop computer skills and practical technology knowledge.

## Official Website

- English: https://afghanustad.com/en
- Dari: https://afghanustad.com/fa
- Pashto: https://afghanustad.com/ps

## Information About AfghanUstad

Use the official website to learn about the institution, its educational programs, courses, learning opportunities, and public announcements.

For the most accurate and current information, follow the relevant pages on the official website.

- English
